description.zh: 把本机登录的 WorkBuddy 模型接入 Operit。侧边栏入口可直接查看账号状态、发起登录、读取模型清单与积分。国内版与国际版两个区域并行使用。本项目改编自 dingminhua/dsh-connect-workbuddy（MIT）。
description.en: Connect locally signed-in WorkBuddy models to Operit. Sidebar entry for account status, sign-in, model catalog and credits. Both regions run in parallel. Adapted from dingminhua/dsh-connect-workbuddy (MIT).
